module_summary: Dual-issue RISC-V decode front end: a fetch_fifo buffers 64-bit fetch pairs (flushed on branch) and presents two instruction slots, each decoded by a biriscv_decoder into functional-unit class flags.

anchors.name: fetch_in_valid_i
anchors.why: Fetch pair valid; pushes into fetch FIFO

anchors.name: fetch_in_instr_i
anchors.why: 64-bit instruction pair written into FIFO, zeroed on fault

anchors.name: fetch_in_accept_o
anchors.why: FIFO accept backpressure to fetch stage

anchors.name: fetch_in_pc_i
anchors.why: PC of fetch pair stored in FIFO

anchors.name: fetch_in_fault_fetch_i
anchors.why: Fetch fault; zeroes instruction and passes as FIFO info

anchors.name: fetch_in_fault_page_i
anchors.why: Page fault; zeroes instruction and passes as FIFO info

anchors.name: fetch_in_pred_branch_i
anchors.why: Branch prediction bits stored with fetch pair

anchors.name: branch_request_i
anchors.why: Branch redirect flushes the fetch FIFO

anchors.name: fetch_out0_valid_o
anchors.why: Slot 0 instruction valid from FIFO, also decoder valid

anchors.name: fetch_out0_instr_o
anchors.why: Slot 0 instruction from FIFO, decoded by u_dec0

anchors.name: fetch_out0_accept_i
anchors.why: Issue accepts slot 0; pops FIFO slot

anchors.name: fetch_out0_pc_o
anchors.why: PC of slot 0 instruction

anchors.name: fetch_out0_instr_exec_o
anchors.why: Slot 0 decoded class flag; representative of exec/lsu/branch/mul/div/csr

anchors.name: fetch_out0_instr_invalid_o
anchors.why: Slot 0 illegal instruction flag from decoder

anchors.name: fetch_out0_instr_rd_valid_o
anchors.why: Slot 0 writes destination register

anchors.name: fetch_out0_fault_fetch_o
anchors.why: Slot 0 fetch fault info from FIFO, feeds decoder fault input

anchors.name: fetch_out1_valid_o
anchors.why: Slot 1 instruction valid from FIFO, also decoder valid

anchors.name: fetch_out1_instr_o
anchors.why: Slot 1 instruction from FIFO, decoded by u_dec1

anchors.name: fetch_out1_accept_i
anchors.why: Issue accepts slot 1; pops FIFO slot

anchors.name: fetch_out1_instr_exec_o
anchors.why: Slot 1 decoded class flag; representative of slot 1 decode outputs

anchors.name: enable_muldiv_w
anchors.why: Parameter-tied enable for mul/div decode in both decoders

groups.name: Fetch FIFO
groups.description: Two-entry fetch pair FIFO with two independently popped slots, flushed on branch

groups.name: Slot 0 decoder
groups.description: Decodes slot 0 instruction into unit class flags

groups.name: Slot 1 decoder
groups.description: Decodes slot 1 instruction into unit class flags
